description: Nodes names every step of an explanation, in the explanation's order
code:
price = 10
qty = 3
shipping = 5
subtotal = price * qty
total = subtotal + shipping
total |> why |> nodes

description: Nodes after stated names the facts that a conclusion rests on
code:
seed = 2
middle = seed + 3
result = middle * 2
result |> why |> stated |> nodes

description: Nodes after derived names the conclusions on the way to a value
code:
seed = 2
middle = seed + 3
result = middle * 2
result |> why |> derived |> nodes

description: Nodes after affects names what a change of one fact reaches
code:
rate = 0.2
price = 10
subtotal = price * 3
tax = subtotal * rate
total = subtotal + tax
price |> affects |> nodes

description: Nodes on the model names every node in model order and leaves out a declaration that holds reasoning
code:
a = 1
b = a + 2
names = b |> why |> nodes
model |> nodes

description: A prefix stage composes with nodes
code:
a = 1
b = a + 2
c = b * 2
why c |> nodes

description: A reference alone names its own node
Nodes after depth names a conclusion and what it reads directly
code:
price = 10
qty = 3
shipping = 5
subtotal = price * qty
total = subtotal + shipping
total |> why |> depth(1) |> nodes

description: Nodes after path names the steps by which one value reaches another
code:
price = 10
qty = 3
shipping = 5
subtotal = price * qty
total = subtotal + shipping
total |> why |> path(price) |> nodes

description: Nodes after intersect names the causes two explanations share
code:
price = 10
quantity = 3
rate = 0.2
subtotal = price * quantity
tax = subtotal * rate
shipping = quantity * 2
tax |> why |> intersect(shipping |> why) |> nodes

description: A standing declaration of node names follows a rewiring of the graph
code:
a = 1
b = a + 2
c = b * 2
names = c |> why |> nodes
x = 5
b = x + 1
names

description: A class-level rule names the nodes behind each instance's own value
code:
rate = 2
class Machine(load, hours):
    this.load = load
    this.hours = hours
$Machine.wear = $Machine.load * $Machine.hours * rate
$Machine.inputs = $Machine.wear |> why |> nodes
press = Machine(5, 10)
press.inputs
